notes.title: Check the game of my friend that just released! HOT!
notes.content:
[h1]Hot Release!: Zapling Bygone[/h1]

My friend Stevie from 9 Finger Games spent two years on making his dream come true, his own video game, he did everything on his own and even dropped a 100k offer from a publisher because he wanted to keep all control. He's got all my respect , [b]and his game is insane! [/b]

Procedural tentacle animations combined with hand drawn pixel art, what are you waiting for? show him some love! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: SPECIAL FEATURES
notes.content:
Dr. Kucho! will be streaming during the Steam Next Fest. He will be talking about [b]special features[/b]:

[list]
[*] Gif Maker
[*] Retro Screen Manager
[*] Color Palettes
[*] Twitch Integration
[*] Gameplay features:
[list]
[*] Gadgets
[*] Enemies
[*] Vehicles
[*] Fluids interaction
[/list]
[/list]
Come and join us to know more about this [b]retro action "save-them-all" platformer[/b] with an unique retro feel. Complete rescue missions leading your colleagues to the closest base station. Fight enemies, destroy terrain and even make new paths with the ground maker.

If you want to see this streaming, click on [b]"set a reminder"[/b] button on the top right and let Steam ping you in time.
